full_title: Antigua and Barbuda - Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions
content_md:
Exercise normal precaution

in **Antigua and Barbuda.**

Antigua and Barbuda is generally a safe destination for travelers.

  * Antigua and Barbuda regularly experiences hurricanes. Review our information on [Weather and Natural Disaster](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/antigua-and-barbuda.html#weather)s in Antigua and Barbuda.
  * Review our [Travel Guidance](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/antigua-and-barbuda.html#requirements) for Antigua and Barbuda to learn how to prepare for a safe trip.
